sourceChecks.text: So he died according to the LORD’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: King Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram was defending Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: but King Joram had returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) Jehu said, “If this is your thinking, then let no one escape and go out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, “I see a company.” Joram said, “Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, ‘Is it peace?’”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Joram said, “Get ready!” They got his chariot ready. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot; and they went out to meet Jehu, and found him on Naboth the Jezreelite’s land.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, “Is it peace, Jehu?” He answered, “What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Joram turned his hands and fled, and said to Ahaziah, “This is treason, Ahaziah!”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Joram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.
